lines.welcome_title: Welcome to Cozy Critter Salon and Spa! Tap Play to start our magical day!
lines.avatar_creator_intro: Let's create your stylist character! Pick your hair, outfit, and name!
lines.avatar_surprise: Ooh, what a super cute style!
lines.enter_salon_first: Welcome to your Cozy Critter Salon! Tap anywhere to walk around, or tap a glowing station!
lines.adopt_capybara: You met a sweet Capybara! He loves warm baths and tangerines. What would you like to name him?
lines.adopt_axolotl: You met a smiley Pink Axolotl! She has feathery pink gills. What should we name her?
lines.adopt_dikdik: You met a tiny Dik-dik antelope! Look at those big sparkly eyes! Pick a cute name!
lines.adopted_celebrate: Hooray! We have a brand new best friend!
lines.station_spa: Spa and Bubble Bath! Tap to give a warm, bubbly scrub!
lines.station_vet: Cozy Vet Clinic! Tap to give a gentle checkup!
lines.station_kitchen: Sunny Kitchen and Cafe! Tap to feed yummy treats!
lines.station_lobby: Cuddle Sanctuary! Tap to pet and brush your critter!
lines.station_yard: Garden Play Yard! Tap to play with toys and catch falling treats!
lines.station_shop: Critter Boutique and Shop! Tap to try on hats, glasses, and room upgrades!
lines.station_photobooth: Sparkle Photo Booth! Tap to strike a pose and take a picture!
lines.station_clipboard: Checkup Clipboard! Let's see what our critters need today!
lines.need_spa_capybara: Your Capybara rolled in the mud! Let's go to the Spa for a warm bubble bath!
lines.need_spa_axolotl: Your Pink Axolotl is a little muddy! Let's visit the Spa for a bubbly wash!
lines.need_spa_dikdik: Your Tiny Dik-dik has muddy paws! Let's head to the Spa for a warm bath!
lines.need_vet_capybara: Your Capybara has a little boo-boo! Let's visit the Vet Clinic for a gentle checkup!
lines.need_vet_axolotl: Your Pink Axolotl needs a checkup! Let's go to the Vet Clinic!
lines.need_vet_dikdik: Your Tiny Dik-dik got twigs in her fur! Let's visit the Vet Clinic!
lines.need_food_capybara: Your Capybara's tummy is rumbling! Let's go to the Kitchen for sweet tangerines!
lines.need_food_axolotl: Your Pink Axolotl is hungry! Let's visit the Kitchen for sea-kelp gummies!
lines.need_food_dikdik: Your Tiny Dik-dik wants a snack! Let's head to the Kitchen for juicy strawberries!
lines.need_love_capybara: Your Capybara wants cuddles and brushing in the Cozy Lobby!
lines.need_love_axolotl: Your Pink Axolotl wants gentle pets in the Cozy Lobby!
lines.need_love_dikdik: Your Tiny Dik-dik wants heart brushing in the Cozy Lobby!
lines.need_play_capybara: Your Capybara is full of happy energy! Let's play outside in the Play Yard!
lines.need_play_axolotl: Your Pink Axolotl wants to play with bubbles in the Play Yard!
lines.need_play_dikdik: Your Tiny Dik-dik wants to bounce in the Play Yard!
lines.spa_step_soap: Step one! Drag the flower soap sponge to scrub all the mud into fluffy bubbles!
lines.spa_step_rinse: Step two! Drag the warm showerhead to rinse away the soapy foam!
lines.spa_step_dry: Step three! Use the cozy towel and warm dryer to fluff dry the water drops!
lines.spa_step_teeth: Step four! Brush those little teeth until they sparkle and shine!
lines.spa_complete: Sparkly clean! What a wonderful bubble bath! You earned shiny coins and a star!
lines.vet_step_stethoscope: Step one! Hold the stethoscope on the chest to listen to the lub-dub heartbeat!
lines.vet_step_tweezers: Step two! Gently pull the little twigs out and drop them into the tray!
lines.vet_step_thermometer: Step three! Check the temperature, then cool the warm forehead with the icy pack!
lines.vet_step_bandage: Step four! Dab soothing cream on the scrapes and put on a cute rainbow bandage!
lines.vet_step_vitamin: Step five! Feed a yummy pink heart vitamin gummy to feel one hundred percent better!
lines.vet_complete: All better! You are the kindest pet doctor ever! Here are your coins and star!
lines.kitchen_intro: Yum! Drag delicious healthy fruits or silly cafe treats right to your hungry pet's mouth!
lines.kitchen_fav: Ooh, that is their absolute favorite treat! Look at all those happy hearts!
lines.kitchen_complete: Tummy full and so happy! Thank you chef! Here are your coins and star!
lines.lobby_intro: Drag your hand or the soft heart brush over your critter to fill the Love Meter with cuddles!
lines.lobby_complete: So much love! Look at that happy critter dance! You earned coins and a star!
lines.yard_intro: Drag the bouncy ball, squeaky duck, or bubble wand to play, or tap Catch Treats for a game!
lines.yard_minigame_start: Slide your critter left and right to catch yummy strawberries, tangerines, and coins!
lines.yard_minigame_complete: Amazing catching! Look at all the treats and coins you collected!
lines.shop_welcome: Welcome to the Critter Boutique! Tap any hat, glasses, outfit, or room upgrade to try it on!
lines.shop_need_coins: Let's care for our pets to earn a few more shiny coins for that!
lines.photobooth_intro: Pick a cute frame, strike a pose, and tap the camera button to snap a photo!
